title: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State Salaries Allowances And Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State Salaries Allowances And Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2001
FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINSTERS
OF STATE (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Federal Ministers
And Ministers of State (Salaries,
Allowances
and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I,
13th August, 2001]
F.No.2(1)/2001‑Pub., dated
13‑8‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXII of 1975), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the President is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No.1 of 1999, read with the Provisional
Constitution (Amendment) Order No.9 of 1999, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President of the Islamic Republic o Pakistan
is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
2. Amendment of section 2, Act
LXII of 1975.‑‑In the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 2, clause (a) shall be omitted.
3. Amendment of section 8, Act
LXII of 1975.‑‑In the said Act, in section 8, for subsection
(4), the following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑ "(4)
"Lump sum utility allowance of fifteen thousand rupees per mensem shall be
paid to a Federal Minister and the Minister of State for payment of utility
bills."
4. Amendment of section 10,
Act LXII of 1975.‑‑In the said Act, in section 10, in the third
proviso, for the words "electricity charges" the words "utility
allowance" shall be substituted.
